note: Canary raster hashes (pixel_sha256 of the decoded RGB) per FreeType version. The renderer never refuses on an unlisted environment (see pinning.py).

evidence.freetype2: The only version measured to change pixels: the Noto variable font differs between FreeType 2.13.3 and 2.14.1/2.14.3 (identical for 2.14.1 and 2.14.3). Pillow 11.3.0 (FT 2.13.3) vs 12.0.0 (FT 2.14.1) vs 13.0.0 (FT 2.14.3).
evidence.harfbuzz: Not shown to matter: box and Noto rasters are identical for HarfBuzz 12.1.0, 12.3.0 and 14.5.0 (FreeType fixed at 2.14.x); box is identical for 11.2.1 as well.
evidence.raqm: Not shown to matter: identical across libraqm 0.10.3 and 0.11.0 (FreeType fixed).
evidence.fribidi: Not shown to matter: identical for libfribidi 1.0.8, 1.0.13 and 1.0.16 (Pillow 13.0.0, both canaries).
evidence.pillow: Not shown to matter beyond the bundled FreeType: box raster identical for Pillow 11.3.0, 12.0.0, 12.1.0, 13.0.0. Pillow is pinned exactly in uv.lock anyway.
evidence.machine: Only x86_64 measured. aarch64 is unmeasured; the clean-image CI job has an arm64 leg that fails (strict) if it differs.
evidence.png_bytes: Not part of the key: file bytes depend on the zlib build; the verifier's PNG hash difference is UNEXPLAINED (see PR #72, scripts/probe_render_env.py).
